Elegant Build.description:
💪 Build: Elegant Build
Graceful and refined proportions — moderate height with a poised frame. Everything looks intentional and composed, as if designed for formal settings.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Elegant Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Elegant frame — graceful proportions, long neck, defined but not heavy shoulders. The body carries itself with visible lightness, clean lines throughout. Female: shoulders sloped and narrow, long slender neck, fine jaw with a soft chin, a shallow chest line above a long waist. Male: shoulders straight and lean, long neck, clean-lined jaw, a flat chest on a long clean torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at this refinement.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
